doc: Quantisation methods a Hugging Face checkpoint can announce (`quantization_config.quant_method`) that no built-in descriptor reads yet. A model that uses one is refused by name — and, so that nobody mistakes the refusal for a verdict on the model, preflight lists the method here as known and not yet described, with what writing its descriptor takes. Writing one is a file (misaka.palw.quant-format.v1), not a release; the ones marked `queued` are next.

methods.title: bitsandbytes
methods.note: nf4 and fp4 (16-entry codebooks, one absmax per block, the absmax itself 8-bit quantised under a second level when `bnb_4bit_use_double_quant`), and LLM.int8 (row-wise int8 with per-row scales; the outlier-threshold variant decomposes the matmul at run time and is refused by name)

methods.title: OCP MXFP4 from safetensors (gpt-oss)
methods.note: expert tensors fused on a leading expert axis, `_blocks` (two 4-bit codes a byte) and `_scales` (e8m0, one a block of 32): needs a descriptor with an expert axis and per-block e8m0 scales over a 3-D tensor

methods.title: Half-Quadratic Quantization
methods.note: per-group scale and zero point with an optional offset axis and packed codes; a descriptor is expressible, none written yet

methods.title: Additive Quantization of Language Models
methods.note: multi-codebook additive codes with per-group scales: a codebook gather and a sum per weight; expressible in principle, none written yet

methods.title: QuIP / QuIP#
methods.note: lattice codebooks under incoherence processing: the weights are decoded and then rotated by Hadamard transforms at run time, which is not a static decode; refused until a transform feature exists

methods.title: Vector Post-Training Quantization
methods.note: vector codebooks with residual and outlier parts; none written yet

methods.title: torchao
methods.note: tensors serialised as Python objects (pickle), not safetensors tensors: refused, not described

methods.title: FBGEMM FP8
methods.note: float8 weights with a scale per output row (`weight_scale`); a floats descriptor like CT_FP8_CHANNEL, none written yet

methods.title: EETQ int8
methods.note: int8 weights with a per-channel scale; none written yet

methods.title: SpQR
methods.note: grouped codes with a sparse outlier set in CSR form; none written yet

methods.title: HIGGS
methods.note: Hadamard-rotated grid quantisation (a run-time transform); refused until a transform feature exists

methods.title: BitNet b1.58
methods.note: ternary weights with a per-tensor scale; activation quantisation is part of the layer; none written yet
